name: Impact Trial: Hyperchaos
detailed_description:
Impact Trial: Hyperchaos is a brutally intense 2D bullet hell arcade where every second counts, and your only mission is to survive… if you can.

*

⚠️ Face endless waves of enemies in a pure action experience where the difficulty dynamically adapts to your performance in real time. The better you play, the more relentless it gets. Can you keep up with the chaos… or will you be eliminated?

FEATURES

  • 🧠 Adaptive difficulty: The game monitors your skill and adjusts intensity on the fly.

  • 🎯 5 fixed difficulty levels + Adaptive Mode: Choose technical mastery or dynamic survival.

  • 👾 20+ unique enemies: Each difficulty tier introduces enemies with distinct attack patterns.

  • 📈 Online leaderboards: Compete globally for the highest score in every game mode.

  • 🎲 Every run is different: Unpredictable enemy combinations. No two runs are the same.

  • 🎨 Pixel art + chiptune soundtrack: Retro aesthetics with modern energy and fast-paced rhythm.

  • 🕹️ True arcade feel: Built for those who crave challenge, precision, and intensity.

  • ⚡ Quick sessions, endless replayability: Perfect for short bursts… or getting lost for hours.

  • 📷 Capture the chaos: Steam screenshot support built in.

*

🔥 Whether you're chasing high scores, mastering the adaptive curve, or just trying to survive a little longer... this is the bullet hell experience you've been training for.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM)2 Quad 2.7 Ghz, AMD Phenom(TM)II X4 3 Ghz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GT 620M, Radeon HD 5770
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 660
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
